description: Expanding the dynamic value gives the dynamic value
notes: The spec says the expanded argument must evaluate to a list or tuple, and that the dynamic value behaves as a value of the expected type, but not how its elements would map to parameters. hashicorp/hcl returns the dynamic value for an expanded argument that is unknown or of the dynamic pseudo-type, before evaluating the other arguments or mapping them to parameters (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go).
